add.event: 瑞典银行危机后，民众对私人银行与私人发钞机构的支持上升
add.evidence: Following a bank crisis in 1857, there was a rise in popular support for private banks and private money issuers

add.event: 瑞典议会通过新银行法，放开利率管制
add.evidence: A new bank law was adopted by parliament in 1864, deregulating the interest rate.

add.event: 瑞士联邦银行法颁布前，银行管辖权一直归各州
add.evidence: Cantons retained jurisdiction over banking until the enactment of the Federal Banking Law of 1881.
In 1901, issuing of private money was prohibited.
